we are able to obtain the integrated gluon densities for different nuclei in the framework the BK equation with local in impact parameter dependence and with the initial conditions that are based on the DGLAP evolution.
the local impact parameter dependence BK equation with the GBW type initial conditions can be successfully used for the description of the DIS on nuclei at low and intermediate x.
